summary: Scans a contact-record array starting at a2 and zeroes every 16-byte record whose four float components match the reference contact position stored in the owning struct at this+0x1C through this+0x28. The number of records processed is derived from the contact count at this+0x1058. The function has 31 statically recorded callers, all with texture/vertex decoder or input-read names.

operations.description: Guard: enter the scan only while a2 is below a2 + 16 * (contact count at this+0x1058); bounds the record array.
Compute the record iteration count as ((16 * count - 1) >> 4) + 1 from the contact count at this+0x1058.
Iterate the record array from a2+8 advancing by 4 floats (16 bytes) per record until the computed count is exhausted.
Guard: a record matches when its four float components equal the reference contact components at this+0x1C, this+0x20, this+0x24 and this+0x28.
Zero all four float components of a matched record (array element written back; the array itself is a2, not a struct field).
